# `compat/profile-cache.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/profile-cache.js`

profile-cache.js — persist & version compatibility profiles. Storage layout (via the kernel StorageManager facade): /os/compat/profiles/{id}.json        ← active (stable or testing) profile /os/compat/index.json                ← { [id]: { knownVersions: [...] } } /os/compat/snapshots/{id}/{ts}.json  ← runtime snapshots (Phase 7) If no storage facade is provided (or a write fails), it degrades to an in-memory cache so the bootloader still works in a bare harness/test.

## Classes

### `class ProfileCache`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(storage = null)` |  |
| `init` | `async init()` |  |
| `find` | `async find(id)` | Find a saved profile for an app id (or null). |
| `save` | `async save(id, profile, sourceHash = null)` | Save/promote a profile. Tracks knownVersions by sourceHash, marking the newest as 'testing' until `promote()` flips it to 'stable'. |
| `promote` | `async promote(id, sourceHash)` | Mark a hash as stable (it booted successfully). |
| `knownVersions` | `async knownVersions(id)` | Known versions for an app id. |
| `isKnownStable` | `async isKnownStable(id, sourceHash)` | True if this exact source hash was seen and marked stable before. |
| `saveSnapshot` | `async saveSnapshot(id, snapshot)` | Persist a runtime snapshot (Phase 7). |
| `purge` | `async purge(id)` | Forget everything cached for an app id: in-memory profile, persisted profile JSON, runtime snapshots, and the index entry. Used when an app is uninstalled with "also delete cached data". |
